why: The power step's OWN move for one gear tier (lane/r9-power-step; re-cut lane/gear-catalogue-steps): the same kits on the same dice, every worn piece read one tier (GEAR_STEPS.tierSteps item Levels) higher by the power step (src/core/hunt/danger.js itemLevelOf), so every hero's offense and defense are one tier of power steps higher and nothing else moves. On the scale a piece fights at the ground's base item Level (src/core/gear-stats.js scaleItems), so moving the ground's gearLevel would move the stats too; this moves only the pieces. The paired held step against the tree (C0) is what one tier of the step moves (target about 20, 15 to 26 in band)
assumptions: One tier is GEAR_STEPS.tierSteps item Levels on a whole kit (src/data/gear-steps.js), that many steps of power at weightGear 1000 (500 under the base)
Shipped gear stats do not move here: on the scale every piece fights at the ground's base item Level (lane/gear-catalogue-steps)
